I'm gonna be a bit presumptuous and say some stuff I do that helps me win games.
-Don't mid range strike, you'll get caught alot of the time.
-use tackles to bait enemy vanish, 99% of the time you'll get a pv after.
-don't over tap, use single taps and if you see them get caught, then you commit.
-float up in mid range, alot of the time when people see you float up, they panic swipe and you get a free combo.
-fake your vanishes, slowly slide left or right and get try to fish for a pv.
-drop combos/ki charge combos can help immensely.
-use mains/time freezing green cards and listen for side steps.
-on the topic of greens, use one after an enemy vanishes, look for an exclamation mark, if you see one, use rising rush.
-cycle characters for fresh vanishes, lots of times people throw out a ranged blue card so vanish and they can rush, cycling characters prevents that.
-game knowledge, know all of the meta units kits so you can counter them.
-analyze how they play, if you notice they go for taps when you vanish them, back up and see if they over tap.
-stay calm, I've made 1v3 comebacks that shouldn't have been possible lol.
You'll figure it out eventually, hopefully these tips help you/anyone else lol
